# 33 Creative Instagram Post Ideas for Your Pet Business (Photos, Not Videos)

Oct 14

10 min read

If you’re running out of ideas for what to post on Instagram for your pet business, you’re not alone. Coming up with fresh, engaging content that actually gets attention (and leads to paying clients) can feel like a full-time job.

  

I’m Mikaela, the founder of [**Pet Marketing Unleashed**](https://www.petmarketingunleashed.com/home), where we've helped pet business owners like dog walkers, pet sitters, pet photographers since 2017 create stress-free [**brands and websites**](https://www.petmarketingunleashed.com/services) that actually work for them. Around here, we dig into marketing strategies that save you time, reduce burnout, and bring in the right clients.

  

Today, I'm sharing 33 ideas for creative Instagram post ideas (_with examples_) that can help drive loyal followers, create engagement, and produce...ta da...ACTUAL paying clients for your pet business.

  

Because, let's be real... [**Instagram doesn’t want anyone leaving their app**](https://www.petmarketingunleashed.com/post/why-instagram-isnt-getting-you-clients). The moment you, as a business owner, write content that asks people to go back to your website (which you SHOULD do), your engagement drops. Your Instagram Story views go down. The moment you add a URL to your Story, your views go down. They WANT you to pay for these services (hello Instagram and Facebook Ads), so your viewers and engagement drop substantially when you try to get people off their platform without paying.

  

We have to be creative when it comes to Instagram, and that means providing content that your potential clients WANT to digest. Consider how you use Instagram as a user (not a business owner). When you scroll Reels in the evening or pass lunch by scrolling through your feed, are you there to learn about services others are offering or are you there to be entertained? Honestly, that’s a crucial mind shift to consider when it comes to creating content. We put so much pressure on ourselves, especially when our content doesn’t do well. **_But perhaps it’s not your content so much as what people are using the platform for._**

  

Pet Marketing Unleashed digs into alllllll the Instagram scoop and more in this blog post on [**why Instagram isn't getting you more clients for your pet business**](https://www.petmarketingunleashed.com/post/why-instagram-isn-t-getting-you-clients), and I highly suggest you give this one a read before you invest hours upon hours creating Reels without noting a ROI.

  

My advice? Take Instagram for what it is. A place to generate community, support, trust, and engagement. You want a beautiful website for them to land on when they make that initial commitment to learn more, and we can help you there, too, via [**custom website design**](https://www.petmarketingunleashed.com/branding-and-web-design) or [**fully customizable website templates**](https://www.petmarketingunleashed.com/pet-business-website-templates).

  

### Before we jump into the 33 ideas...

  

I want to write a reminder that social media, Instagram especially, is just one piece of your marketing strategy.

  

If you’re tired of feeling like you have to constantly post just to stay visible, SEO can help bring the _right_ pet owners to your website long after you hit publish.

➡️ [**Grab free access to our FREE SEO audit**](https://www.petmarketingunleashed.com/module1). Inside, you'll be able to complete a SEO audit making sure you have the foundations set, and from there, you know what to tackle next to increase your visibility on Google and in AI search!

  

[

![Free SEO Course Module opt-in graphic.](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/cd132e_0e7df88667b941079e938e85994ed4bc~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_147,h_30,al_c,q_80,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,blur_2,enc_avif,quality_auto/cd132e_0e7df88667b941079e938e85994ed4bc~mv2.jpg)



](https://www.petmarketingunleashed.com/module1)

  

Alrighty, now let's get into the 33 creative Instagram photo post ideas for your pet business!

  

Before we begin, one of the most important things in creating a solid Instagram strategy is having consistent branding. If this is something you need help with, check out our [**Branding**](https://www.petmarketingunleashed.com/vip-days) **Week.** Not only will you get a stunning logo, color palette, typography, and more, but we can also help with social media templates, icons, and more so that you feel confident sharing your business in a cohesive manner on social media.

  

Alright...let's get to the ideas!

  

## 1\. Share Quotes.

###   

People love short, inspiring, or funny quotes—especially if they involve pets. These types of posts are highly shareable, quick to make, and often get strong engagement. In the pet industry, you could share quotes from movies, authors, or even create your own branded quote graphics.

  

![Example about sharing quotes for an instagram post for your pet business.](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/838616_b2fe5c9f9d1f4a86be55bb1cf0625722~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_147,h_109,al_c,q_80,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,blur_2,enc_avif,quality_auto/838616_b2fe5c9f9d1f4a86be55bb1cf0625722~mv2.jpg)

  

  

## 2\. Share pet care tips and actionable steps.

  

Whether you’re selling products or services, you’re probably getting the same questions from various customers. You can turn those questions into social media posts! Or, just try sharing simple tips for your audience - they do appreciate it!!

  

![Example about sharing pet care tips for an instagram post for your pet business.](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/cd132e_e788a2a9615a46da818f8b2feb1f635b~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_147,h_212,al_c,q_80,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,blur_2,enc_avif,quality_auto/cd132e_e788a2a9615a46da818f8b2feb1f635b~mv2.jpg)

  

## 3\. Share how-tos.

  

You’re an expert at what you do. Your audience wants to hear from you first! Sometimes we think that because we know something so well, that other people do too. But many times, the opposite is the case, so whatever how-to you’ve got to share, chances are it’s all brand new information for somebody else.

  

![Example about sharing how-tos for an instagram post for your pet business.]
